authorship: Written 19 November 2026 by four agent instances, one per domain, each reading only the frozen corpus and its brief; none saw the matcher, its vocabulary, earlier fixtures or the other domains. Not tuned against.

domains.art: arts, culture, crafts, film, music, storytelling, design, artisans, cultural heritage
domains.software: digital tools, apps, data platforms, sensors and AI, maps and remote sensing, web3
domains.research: scientific study, monitoring, surveys, field data, evaluation, laboratories
domains.place: on-the-ground work with land, water, food, forests, compost, buildings, schools, sites

evidenceTypes.literal: close to how a project describes its work
evidenceTypes.sparse: a 1 to 4 word title and no description
evidenceTypes.cross-language: Portuguese or Spanish, while fitting projects are in another language
evidenceTypes.hard-negative: shares obvious words with projects that do not fit; may have none that fit
evidenceTypes.no-match: no project in the corpus fits, in the author's judgment

rubric: partner-real-rubric-v1: a need is served by a project whose described work could plausibly provide what is needed; an offer by a project that could plausibly use what is offered, given what it describes doing. A nearby but different activity is not relevant, and shared vague words are not a reason. Availability, price, distance and language are ignored. Judged from the listed passages only.

thresholds.source: docs/platform/05-technical-spec.md quality criteria: at least 80 percent relevant returned top-five suggestions per domain/direction on held-out queries with known relevant candidates; zero unsupported confirmed assertions. No recall floor has been agreed, so recall is reported, not gated.
